_doc: Đợt 2 rương Mimic: tiếng bay (dép lê bị ném xoay tròn) và tiếng mở (dép rơi vào miệng rương, rương nhai). Chạy: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=dummy python3 -I Tools/Audio/make_elevenlabs_chest_sfx.py --manifest Tools/Audio/manifests/chest_mimic.json

items.prompt: a rubber flip-flop sandal thrown through the air, spinning fast: three quick airy whoosh-whoosh-whoosh swishes getting closer, soft flapping of the rubber strap, no music, no voice

starts instantly with a loud wet rubber slap as a flip-flop drops onto a wooden chest, then a hungry wooden monster chest chomping it: two fast wet chews with wood creaks, a slurp and one deep gulp at the end, no music, no voice
